messages:
Tariq: ran a 4-GPU nsys capture of the inference pipeline on prod-like load, looks like kernel-selector decision time is colliding with NCCL all-reduce windows. attaching highlights below.

Elaine: can you paste the nvtx slices? :eyes:

Tariq: main snippet from the timeline:
```
[0000.000] nvtx: KERNEL_SELECT start (seq=142)
[0000.012] CUDA kernel: attention_kv_fwd    12.3ms
[0000.025] nvtx: KERNEL_SELECT end (seq=142)
[0000.026] NCCL: allReduce start (ring 0)
[0000.045] NCCL: allReduce end   (overlap with next kernel)
```

Simon: that 1ms gap between selector end and NCCL start is suspicious — could be sync on CPU path. Did selector block on memcpy or host->device enqueue?

Tariq: good call. nvprof shows a host->device memcpy of ~0.9ms right before NCCL kickoff. suspect we do an extra small staging copy for KV handshake on multi-gpu path.

Maria: repro steps? I can run a lighter profile with `--sample-freq` to reduce noise.

Tariq: command I used: `nsys profile -o /tmp/run1 --trace=nvtx,cuda,nccl --sample=none --force-overwrite --capture-range=nvtx` then converted to perfetto for cross-gpu view. upload: https://redwood-internal-storage/profiler/run1.perfetto (internal)

PerfBot: automated analysis: found 3 NVTX ranges where selector latency > 10ms and introduced a blocking cudaMemcpy at the tail of the range. Suggested check: `KVCache::handshake_async` path.

Elaine: if KV handshake is forcing host staging for small KV keys we should change to pipelined device-resident enqueue. Might need to adjust batching heuristic to group those requests so selector work moves earlier.

Simon: timeline shows repeated pattern: selector -> small memcpy -> NCCL allreduce -> kernel bubble -> next kernel. Looks like NCCL starts while device still waiting for all peer kernels. allreduce overlaps are not optimal. Could be ring order mismatches due to our stream assignment.

Tariq: agreed. next steps I want to: 1) add NVTX around the KV handshake internals, 2) run capture with `--capture-range=nvtx` focusing on single batch edge-case, 3) try binding NCCL to non-default stream to avoid implicit sync. i'll pick this up.

Maria: I'll try a quick patch to make KV handshake device->device if small (<4KB) and run perfetto diff. will tag you @Tariq.

Elaine: thanks. if we confirm it's a stream sync, we can fix kernel-selector to issue async ops earlier in the pipeline. low-risk change and big ROI. :thumbsup:

Tariq: filing follow-up ticket with trace links and perf-bot suggestions. assigning to Maria for first patch, Simon for nccl/stream experiment. will post results here.

PerfBot: ticket created: PF-3245 - "KV handshake host staging causing NCCL phasing bubbles". priority P2.

Simon: cool, I'll run microbench with `nccl-tests` to verify ring ordering doesn't regress.

Maria: starting a run now, will post a short flame screenshot when done.
